steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...Sonny.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: We did this of our own volition.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: I don't get it, Doc Moore... who are you talking for here?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Message.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: I received a message, one that is different from that previous ones.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Hngh...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Does your head hurt again, Joyce?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: There is nothing wrong with me physically, Dr. Silence.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Detecting unexpected data transmission. Processing.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Data?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes... Sonny, we all know...

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: This is... a gamble.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: The results are... unpredictable. But this was our choice.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Data transmission terminated. Analysis indicates that Sonny is the intended recipient.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doc Moore, you're talking like one of our... no, one of the test subjects lying there.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Hypothesis cannot be confirmed.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: The source of the data is unknown. I simply sensed it.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doc Silence, is she right? Doc Moore can hear my friends?!

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Joyce, was your use of the word 'sense' intentional?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Yes, Dr. Silence.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: The content of the dream has changed.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What did you see?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Analysis failed.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Your eyes look different... are you feeling sad?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Detecting signal fluctuations in peripheral system.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: ...Della.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Dellareed? Are you thinking of her again? Does Device #9 have something to do with Director Franks's experiments?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Motive, emotion, not logical connections.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Dr. Silence, I sense that this was our own choice.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Your own choice?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Sonny, if I guarantee that I will do all that can be done to correct the wrongs, will you let Dorothy Franks go?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Listen, Doc Silence, we appreciate your help getting us here, and that you got us to the truth about the experiments.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: We can definitely believe you're on our side.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: But can you really be sure she won't start it all back up again?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: No, I can't.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: But if she does, I will handle her for you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Whew... the experiments have been suspended, Dorothy is unharmed, and the test subjects are regaining consciousness.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I still find all this hard to believe.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: There is no cause for alarm. Emotional fluctuations are normal.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You woke up just in time, Joyce.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I've never seen Olivia that angry... I thought she would just leave Dorothy to her own devices.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But I still don't understand how you heard the voices of the test subjects.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Their consciousnesses were linked by Dorothy's 'Hub', but how did you get involved?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Didn't you say Device #9 had nothing to do with the 'Hub'?

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Insufficient data available.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: But I heard the voice of Mr. Myers when I woke up from my dream.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: When you woke up...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The conflict in the corridor? Why would that wake you, when the battle before didn't?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: This is all so strange...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Anyway, I guess all's well that ends well. Thanks to Olivia.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Dr. Silence has met expectations.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: She's changed so much, come to think of it.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: When I first met her, she was just one of many students you'd see on a college campus, shy, introverted, unremarkable.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: This description matches my memory.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I could hardly recognize her when she was pressing Dorothy for answers, only to step in to protect her.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It was like I saw... a shadow of someone else.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: That of Director Saria?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: H-How did you know?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Don't tell Olivia I said that!

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Dr. Silence won't let this affect her friendship with you.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: But as her friend, I don't want to remind her of her unpleasant past.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Let's go. I should finish my job too.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Communications have yet to be restored... not good. The boss...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: And my sister... how many messages have I been getting?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Please come with me, Director Franks. It's time to leave.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: One moment, please.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: With the experiments halted, they will wipe this lab off the map.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: There's something I have to take with me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: It's... a photo?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: A photo of a group of Pioneers...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Is this girl... you?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I meant every word I said to Sonny.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: My mother, my whole family... they were all Pioneers.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: From a young age I heard them talk about their dreams and saw their struggles with my own eyes.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: They gave me a chance to chase my own dreams.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: But most Pioneers will never know the luck that came to me.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: What happened to your family?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Most of them have left me.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: When I was invited to attend Ironforge Polytechnic's summer camp for 'talented students'...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: A Catastrophe destroyed my mother's camp.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: She never heard about my miraculous acceptance, or my scholarship.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Was it really the right choice to stop these experiments?

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: Those Pioneers, those whose lives hang by a thread, they live each day not knowing if they'll see the next.

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: I could have helped them...

steps.name: Dorothy
steps.text: They didn't have to be swallowed up by the sand in despair, like my family was.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Why do you ask this, Silence?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: Without our experiments, the child would not have lasted more than a few days after leaving Haydn 1.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: We saved her life. She wants for nothing, and will contribute to scientific advancement.

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: How lucky is she, compared to all those children who die of Oripathy in the barrenlands?

steps.name: Parvis
steps.text: I trusted you, put you in charge of her. Yet you make such petty accusations towards me, towards science itself?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I don't know.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: This is not a question for me to answer.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Joyce reminded me...

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: I should not judge things by my own standards, even if I can never accept what you did.

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: Did we not choose to be tormented by uncertainty and self-doubt?

steps.name: Silence
steps.text: As researchers, it's our duty to seek the answer ourselves.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Is everything ready?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Our team has entered the site and is approaching the lab area.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Good. Get ready.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Colonel, I know there have been delays, but if you give me a little more time...

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: You never told me there were other people at the site, Clooney.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Do you mean the pharmaceutical company?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: There's nothing to worry about. They're partnered with Rhine Lab. I will...

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: I don't need your promises.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: All I need here is results.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I apologize. This is just a small hiccup...

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: If you can't deliver results, then you have to at least stop making trouble for me.

steps.name: Colonel's Voice
steps.text: You'd do well to remember that.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Can we proceed, Director Clooney?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: We don't have a choice.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: One more thing.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Put me on spec com.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Huh... communications have been restored?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Elena.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Director?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I'm so glad it's you. I've been trying to reach you... did you get my message? I put everything that happened here in my report.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Something's wrong with Dorothy... Director Franks's experiments. But Silence and I have things under control.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: We've settled things with the Pioneers. They're leaving the labs as we speak.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: You... you do? Oh wow...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: You did your job. The cleanup detail is on the way in.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Defense? They're finally here?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Whew, that's a relief. I was worried about the Transmitter we've been storing here.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: They know what to do. You can leave now.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I should stay and help. Next to Dorothy, I'm the most familiar with these experiments.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: I'm at the observation station, Elena. Two directors are more than enough to handle the situation, don't you agree?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Er, that's not what I meant...

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Then listen to me and leave the site immediately.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: May I ask why?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No, you may not waste my time with meaningless questions. I want you in the control room, now.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Yes... sir.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Is there a problem, Researcher Urbica?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The director... Ferdinand wants me to leave immediately.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: Leave?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Go and let Olivia know that the Defense Section is coming.

steps.name: Ptilopsis
steps.text: What about you? Are you leaving?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... something's not right with the director. If... if he didn't know how far Dorothy went, why is he completely unconcerned about what happened to the experiments?

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Director Clooney, Miss Urbica is not leaving the labs.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Should we adjust the plan?

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Ferdinand
steps.text: Proceed.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Is everybody out?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Yes, sir.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Next.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What are they doing?

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: They say it's a 'precautionary measure'. Probably a sedative or something.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: I guess we made a little too much noise, huh?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Don't forget what I said. If anyone asks, I was the one behind everything.

steps.name: Pioneer Team Member
steps.text: Don't worry, no one's letting you take all the credit.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Next.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Sonny Romano.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Wasn't asking for your name.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Tell your leader that I take sole responsibility for the kidnapping.

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: Right hand.

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Are you gonna get to it after the injection?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What the...? Doc Urbica? Why'd you push me?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Don't take the shot!

steps.name: Rhine Defense Member
steps.text: You're interfering with our work, researcher.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I developed that stuff in that syringe.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Need me to explain what it's for?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Huh? Aren't they with you and Doc Silence?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Why do you always doubt the people you should trust, when you're so eager to trust people you should doubt?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Take that band off, quick!

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: The treatment wristband?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I remembered why Joyce woke up when I saw the syringes in their hands!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's this—the treatment bands!

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: The ones you got have been modified. There's a sensor on them similar to the equipment in Dorothy's lab. If it comes into contact with Transmitter...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I need to report to the director. Someone is behind all this, using... using...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Dammit, communications are down again?

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: I... I get it now.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: All this time...

steps.name: Sonny
steps.text: Doc Urbica, are you okay? Are you crying?

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: Crying? No, I just...

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: It's not important.

steps.name: Elena
steps.text: This isn't over, Sonny. Dorothy was never your enemy!
